summary: Frontend regression for iteration 11 (editorial redesign + Google Ads compliance + trackConversion). Tested Home, Services, Pricing, BookingGuide (/nasil-rezervasyon), Contact, Blog, Gallery, FAQ across TR/EN. All new editorial layouts render correctly, gallery has 24 cards with first 6 items swapped to stage/DJ/bottle/laser/vocals, contact form submits + toast shows + form clears, language switcher works, all trackConversion data-testids present. One Google Ads compliance violation found: Home hero marquee still contains 'MERCEDES · YAT · CASINO' / 'MERCEDES · YACHT · CASINO' (both TR & EN). data/landings.js still contains extensive Mercedes/BMW/Maybach/Range Rover content which is reachable via /:slug catch-all route.

ui_bugs.issue: Marquee still contains 'MERCEDES · YAT · CASINO' (TR) and 'MERCEDES · YACHT · CASINO' (EN) — violates test criterion #2 (no vehicle brand names on any page). Located in /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx lines 39 & 47.

Landing page data still contains 'Girne Mercedes VIP Transfer Servisi' with Mercedes S-Class, E-Class, V-Class, Maybach, Range Rover, BMW 7 Series references. Reachable via /:slug route (e.g., /mercedes-transfer). Violates Google Ads compliance criterion #1 & #2.

issues: First blog card (blog-card-girne-vip-turizm-rehberi) className does NOT include 'md:col-span-2' — check if it should visually span 2 cols per test criterion #7. Currently uses hotel/lounge Kyrenia image (photo-1566073771259) which is on-brand and passes the 'no houseplants/library' check.

action_items: Remove 'MERCEDES · YAT · CASINO' and 'MERCEDES · YACHT · CASINO' from Home.jsx marqueeItems (lines 39, 47). Suggested replacement: 'SAHNE · YAT · CASINO' / 'STAGE · YACHT · CASINO'.

Sanitize /app/frontend/src/data/landings.js — remove Mercedes / BMW / Maybach / Range Rover names from the mercedes-transfer landing (or delete/rename the entire landing). This is reachable via /:slug catch-all and violates Google Ads compliance.
Verify featured blog card (blog-card-girne-vip-turizm-rehberi) has md:col-span-2 class applied — currently missing per DOM inspection.
critical_code_review_comments: The /:slug catch-all in App.js line 43 renders LandingPage for any unknown path (returns 'landing-not-found' skeleton). This masked our initial confusion when /rezervasyon (which doesn't exist as a route — actual route is /nasil-rezervasyon) rendered a blank page. Consider adding a proper 404 component or aliasing common expected paths.
